text: {"lessons":["A few months of losses do not prove that my holdings were mistakes; prices move unpredictably, so I should not sell just to avoid admitting a loss.","I should review whether each holding still fits my goals and risk tolerance, rather than letting its average cost or my reluctance to realize a loss decide for me.","Since I check only a few times a year and rarely trade, I should make deliberate decisions when I review my account, not react to short-term swings."]}
